title: 4 Chords | Music Videos | The Axis Of Awesome
summary: A comedy-music medley from the Australian band The Axis of Awesome showing that dozens of famous pop songs use the same four-chord progression. The performers cycle through a long list of hits over the same chords.
why: HN commenters use it as the canonical demonstration that popular songs reuse one chord progression, especially in threads on music analysis and AI-generated music.

quote.text: the "4 Chords" medley by Axis of Awesome is a great demonstration of its ubiquity
